title: Austin Charts Future Policy Direction
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   Austin officials convened a special meeting focused entirely on the city's strategic future.
*   The primary agenda item was a high-level discussion to define upcoming policy priorities and goals for Austin.
*   Attendees explored the potential impacts these strategic objectives would have on city governance.
*   This foundational session was crucial for outlining the city's agenda and setting the stage for future initiatives.

SPECIAL CALLED MEETING 
 
Wednesday, January 11, 2017 
The Austin City Council will convene at 9:00 AM on 
Wednesday, January 11, 2017 at the 
AT&T Executive Education and Conference Center, Room # 301 
The University of Texas, 1900 University Ave., Austin 
 
 
 
Mayor Steve Adler 
Mayor Pro Tem Kathie Tovo, District 9

the City of Austin.
